_okx_api_base_comment: TBD — runner verifies endpoints on startup. The user accesses OKX EU via https://my.okx.com/nl; if the EU edge needs a different host the runner will surface auth errors on first call and we set this field (e.g. https://eea.okx.com or whichever EU host the API portal lists).
_leverage_cap_comment: TBD — runner verifies via /api/v5/account/leverage-info at startup. If EU retail caps below 2× the runner refuses to start with a clear MISMATCH log line; lower this field and restart.
_trailing_window_comment: Intended 90d of 8h settlements. HONEST EFFECTIVE WINDOW: OKX's funding-rate-history page is capped at 100 rows and the runner does not paginate it, so the window holds min(270, 100) = 100 settlements (~33d). It is rebuilt WHOLESALE from settled history once per 8h settlement — never appended per 60s cycle (review 2026-06-09 #1).
_cycle_comment: Health check / market data each cycle; funding settles every 8h; rebalance triggers only when target ≠ current beyond rebalance_threshold_pct.
_okx_base_url_comment: EU host — sleutels gemaakt onder my.okx.com/nl leven hier; www.okx.com geeft 50119 "API key doesn't exist" voor EU-keys
